auth_js_browser_session.lifecycle: Backend access token refresh starts within 5 minutes of expiry.

ops_access_token_hs256.issuer: Former authentication API; no current issuer
ops_access_token_hs256.acceptors: None; every endpoint profile refuses it
ops_access_token_hs256.lifecycle: Retired; do not provision its signing secret.

ops_refresh_token.issuer: Former authentication flow; no current Go issuer
ops_refresh_token.acceptors: None; no endpoint-profile row accepts it. go-api forwards refresh and sign-out to auth-service, which accepts refresh_credential
ops_refresh_token.lifecycle: Retired; a JWT-shaped refresh token is refused at refresh and revokes nothing at sign-out.

refresh_credential.format: Opaque dhr1_ prefix and 32 random bytes
refresh_credential.lifecycle: 7-day rolling lifetime; single use; 30-second grace; reuse revokes the family.

user_access_token.acceptors: go-api and query-api for dev-health-api; auth-service session routes for auth-service
user_access_token.storage: Stateless token; auth.sessions and user state are checked live
user_access_token.lifecycle: Reissued on refresh; 5 to 60 minutes, default 60 minutes.

workload_token.acceptors: Audience-bound internal routes and authorization decision routes
workload_token.storage: Stateless token; workload registry holds identity and allowed actions
workload_token.lifecycle: Re-exchange before expiry; at most 300 seconds, bounded by the subject credential.

social_oauth_exchange.storage: Transient callback data; not persisted by the backend
social_oauth_exchange.lifecycle: One sign-in exchange; provider controls expiry.

sso_saml_exchange.storage: Provider configuration and encrypted secrets in public.sso_providers
sso_saml_exchange.lifecycle: Identity provider controls assertion expiry; replay checks apply; rotate its certificate through configuration.

sso_oidc_exchange.lifecycle: Single exchange; identity provider controls code expiry.

org_context_header.description: Organization context, not an authentication credential
org_context_header.acceptors: Organization-scoped routes after authentication and membership checks
org_context_header.storage: Request only; membership is database state
org_context_header.lifecycle: Per request; confers no authority by itself.

impersonation_session.description: Effective-user context with a real actor
impersonation_session.issuer: Administrative impersonation and auth-service delegated-session routes
impersonation_session.acceptors: Routes that check live impersonation or delegated-session state
impersonation_session.format: Session id and actor identity; no standalone secret
impersonation_session.lifecycle: Short lived; delegated sessions have no refresh credential; end or expiry removes authority.

internal_svc_acr_token.description: Stored compatibility service credential for Ask Dev
internal_svc_acr_token.lifecycle: Operator rotation with optional overlap; stored rows can be revoked.

internal_svc_worker_token.issuer: No current issuer; creation is disabled
internal_svc_worker_token.lifecycle: Creation and rotation are disabled; existing rows can be listed and revoked.

internal_svc_authsess_token.lifecycle: Operator rotation with optional overlap; use workload identity for session issuance.

acr_client_credential.storage: Digest in the Ask Dev credential store
acr_client_credential.lifecycle: Self-service rotation with bounded overlap; revoked sources cannot rotate.

acr_browser_refresh_token.format: Opaque acrrt_ prefix and 32 random bytes
acr_browser_refresh_token.storage: SHA-256 digest in acr.browser_refresh_tokens; family in acr.browser_token_families
acr_browser_refresh_token.lifecycle: Single use; 30-second grace while the successor is unused; issues a 10-minute client credential.

acr_web_assertion.description: Web workload assertion for Ask Dev
acr_web_assertion.issuer: Web server with its own Ed25519 key
acr_web_assertion.storage: Private key file at web; public JWKS at Ask Dev; public key metadata in the workload registry
acr_web_assertion.lifecycle: At most 30 seconds; single-use token id; rotate by key id with overlap.

acr_workload_identity_exchange.issuer: Kubernetes issues the subject; Ask Dev issues the resulting client credential
acr_workload_identity_exchange.format: Projected ServiceAccount JWT exchanged for an fcacr_ credential
acr_workload_identity_exchange.storage: Result in the Ask Dev credential store with workload provenance
acr_workload_identity_exchange.lifecycle: Re-exchange before the resulting credential expires.

external_push_ingest_token.lifecycle: Expiry and revocation on the credential row; replace through administration.

stripe_webhook_signature.format: Provider signature over the request body
stripe_webhook_signature.lifecycle: Rotate at Stripe and update the configured secret.

github_webhook_signature.issuer: GitHub with the configured shared secret
github_webhook_signature.lifecycle: Rotate at GitHub and update the configured secret.

gitlab_webhook_signature.issuer: GitLab with the configured shared secret
gitlab_webhook_signature.acceptors: No current route accepts it; the GitLab intake route is removed
gitlab_webhook_signature.lifecycle: Retired: go-api reads no GitLab webhook secret.

jira_webhook_signature.issuer: Jira with the configured shared secret
jira_webhook_signature.acceptors: No current route accepts it; the Jira intake route is removed
jira_webhook_signature.lifecycle: Retired: go-api reads no Jira webhook secret.

github_app_installation_token.issuer: Backend signs the App JWT; GitHub issues the installation token
github_app_installation_token.format: RS256 App JWT exchanged for an installation token
github_app_installation_token.storage: App private key in configured credential storage
github_app_installation_token.lifecycle: App JWT is minted per exchange with a 10-minute maximum lifetime; installation token is short lived.

pagerduty_oauth_credential.acceptors: PagerDuty API; worker credential hydration reads the stored pair
pagerduty_oauth_credential.lifecycle: Refresh before expiry under a credential lock.

pagerduty_webhook_signature.acceptors: PagerDuty webhook handler for the addressed binding
pagerduty_webhook_signature.format: HMAC-SHA256; up to eight v1= signature candidates
pagerduty_webhook_signature.lifecycle: Replace the binding secret and the subscription secret together.

llm_api_keys.storage: Per-provider runtime environment or organization credential configuration
llm_api_keys.lifecycle: Rotate at the provider and update the configured key.

email_verification_token.acceptors: go-api verification route; auth-service uses link_credential
email_verification_token.lifecycle: 24 hours; reissue replaces earlier tokens for that user.

password_reset_token.acceptors: go-api password-reset route; auth-service uses link_credential
password_reset_token.lifecycle: 1 hour; reissue replaces earlier tokens for that user.

link_credential.issuer: auth-service local sign-in and recovery flows
link_credential.acceptors: auth-service verification and reset routes, bound to purpose
link_credential.format: Opaque base64url value from 32 random bytes
link_credential.lifecycle: 24 hours for verification; 1 hour for reset; single use; reset is bound to the issuing token version.

org_invite_token.issuer: go-api invitation route or auth-service invitation store
org_invite_token.acceptors: Invitation acceptance routes in go-api and auth-service
org_invite_token.storage: SHA-256 digest in public.org_invites or auth.invites
org_invite_token.lifecycle: Reissue through the invitation flow; acceptance checks expiry and revocation.

license_key.storage: Configured license string; LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY for verification
license_key.lifecycle: Replace at deployment; payload expiry and grace-period checks apply.

infrastructure_deployment_credentials.format: Connection credentials, ServiceAccount tokens or certificates
infrastructure_deployment_credentials.storage: Deployment secret manager or mounted secret files
infrastructure_deployment_credentials.lifecycle: Infrastructure-specific rotation; no single application expiry rule.

effective_principal_envelope.description: Former go-api to query-api principal envelope
effective_principal_envelope.acceptors: None; query-api endpoint profiles refuse it
effective_principal_envelope.format: EdDSA compact JWT with schema version
effective_principal_envelope.storage: Stateless token; former verification JWKS file
effective_principal_envelope.lifecycle: Retired; former lifetime is 60 seconds; no active request path uses it.

kubernetes_sa_token_exchange.format: Bound projected ServiceAccount JWT for dev-health-workload-exchange
kubernetes_sa_token_exchange.storage: Projected file; auth-service does not store the subject token
kubernetes_sa_token_exchange.lifecycle: Kubelet rotates it before expiry; exchange output cannot outlive it.

workload_bootstrap_credential.acceptors: auth-service token exchange when bootstrap is enabled
workload_bootstrap_credential.storage: Value written once to a mode-0600 file; SHA-256 digest in auth.credential_registry
workload_bootstrap_credential.lifecycle: Rotation overlap from 0 to 1 hour; output token cannot outlive the credential.

service_account_key.acceptors: auth-service token exchange when service-account exchange is enabled
service_account_key.storage: SHA-256 digest in auth.credential_registry; value returned once
service_account_key.lifecycle: Rotation overlap from 0 to 24 hours; one current key plus one overlapping key.

service_account_token.acceptors: No public resource route accepts this bearer yet; the exchange verifies its own issued token
service_account_token.storage: Stateless token; account and originating key are checked live
service_account_token.lifecycle: At most 300 seconds; cannot outlive its originating key.

oauth_consent_csrf_token.acceptors: Consent approve and deny routes for the bound web session
oauth_consent_csrf_token.lifecycle: One value per authorization request; never reissued; request expiry applies.
